items.t: SmPC: large data (over 1,000 outcomes) show no malformations or fetal/neonatal toxicity, but as a precaution it is preferable to avoid in pregnancy. No BUMPS leaflet or SPS advice specific to desloratadine found.

src.q: A large amount of data on pregnant women (more than 1,000 pregnancy outcomes) indicate no malformative nor foeto/ neonatal toxicity of desloratadine.
As a precautionary measure, it is preferable to avoid the use of Neoclarityn during pregnancy.

items.t: SmPC: found in breastfed infants; effect unknown. Decide whether to stop breastfeeding or not use desloratadine. (The SPS antihistamine breastfeeding page does not cover desloratadine.)

src.q: Desloratadine has been identified in breastfed newborns/infants of treated women. The effect of desloratadine on newborns/infants is unknown.
A decision must be made whether to discontinue breast-feeding or to discontinue/abstain from Neoclarityn therapy
